name: SVC_MCA_EVENTS
description: This transactional table records the events processed during an interaction.

columns.name: MCA_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: MCA_EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: This is a public surrogate key which is required during creation of the row.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key which refers to SVC_INTERACTIONS table.

columns.name: WRAPUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key which refers to SVC_INTERACT_SUMMARY table.

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Name of the calling event method.

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: Agent identifier from the parties entity.

columns.name: COMM_ID
columns.description: Communication ID represented by the API Event ID.

columns.name: APPL_CLASSIFICATION_CD
columns.description: The application classification to which this event applies.

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Version of the client side consumer.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: A foreign key to the SVC_CHANNELS_B table.

columns.name: TOOLBAR_NAME
columns.description: Toolbar name being used for this event.

columns.name: TOOLBAR_ID
columns.description: A foreign key to the SVC_MCA_TOOLBAR table.

columns.name: BO_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: A foreign key to the SVC_MCA_BO_ENTITY table.

columns.name: UUID
columns.description: Client response unique identifier.

columns.name: ORIGIN
columns.description: URL representing the event initiator.

columns.name: WINDOW_NAME
columns.description: Client window identifier of the event.

columns.name: NEXT_STATE
columns.description: The next state calculated by the event processing.

columns.name: RESULT
columns.description: Returned result of event processing.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG_CD
columns.description: Error code for the event processing.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Error message of the event processing.

columns.name: CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Contact identifier for the event.

columns.name: IN_TOKENS
columns.description: Input tokens of the request payload.

columns.name: DIRECTION_CD
columns.description: Direction of the event for the token values.

columns.name: OUT_TOKENS
columns.description: Output tokens in the response payload.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
